name: AJ1G, Inc.
summary: AJ1G, Inc. operates as a diversified cannabis holding company in Florida. It focuses on operating a cannabis mall that engages in cultivation, manufacturing, distribution, and delivery of THC and CBD distillates and edibles. AJ1G, Inc. was formerly known as Global Consortium Inc. and changed its name to AJ1G, Inc. in October 2021. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Coconut Creek, Florida.
